## Findings
- claim-1: For bigrassmannian \(v=v_{r,s,t,n}\), with \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\), the lower-adjoined family \(G=\{\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}:\rho\subseteq b^a\}\) minimally generates \(J_v\subseteq\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 219-235]
- claim-2: Let \(Q=J_v/A_+J_v\) and \(m=\binom{a+b}{a}\). Then \(Q\cong\mathbb Z^m\) if and only if \(\dim_{\mathbb Q}(Q\otimes\mathbb Q)=m\).
- claim-3: Under the equivalent rational-full-rank hypothesis, the images of \(G\) form a homogeneous integral basis of \(Q\), and \[ \operatorname{Hilb}_{Q}(z)=z^{ij}\binom{a+b}{a}_{z}. \]
- claim-4: Minimality alone does not imply rational full rank: for \(A=\mathbb Z[x]\), \(J=(2x,x^2)\), the irredundant family \(\{2x,x^2\}\) has \(J/A_+J\cong\mathbb Z\oplus\mathbb Z/2\), of rational rank \(1<2\).
- claim-5: A uniform proof that \(\dim_{\mathbb Q}(J_v/A_+J_v)\otimes\mathbb Q=\binom{a+b}{a}\) is not supplied here.
## Strategy
Let \(A=\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\), \(Q=J_v/A_+J_v\), and
\[
G=\{\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}:\rho\subseteq b^a\}.
\]
The source gives that \(G\) generates \(J_v\), hence \(\mathbb ZG\twoheadrightarrow Q\).

For \(a\ge1\), the parameter definitions give
\[
a+j\le r,\qquad a+i\le n-r,\qquad b\le i,j,
\]
so \((n,r,i,j,a,b,N)\) is valid for every \(1\le N\le ab\) [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 276-303].

Suppose a nonzero homogeneous kernel element exists in degree \(ij+N\):
\[
\sum_{|\rho|=N}c_\rho\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}\in A_+J_v.
\]
Using homogeneous generation by \(G\), its right side can be written
\[
\sum_{|\lambda|<N}f_\lambda\bar s_{(i^j,\lambda)},
\qquad \deg f_\lambda=N-|\lambda|>0.
\]
The left side is nonzero because the displayed Schur classes are distinct elements of the Schur basis. This is precisely a prohibited homogeneous syzygy by the source no-syzygy theorem [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 819-825]. Thus \(\mathbb ZG\to Q\) is injective.

For \(N=0\), and separately \(a=0\), \(J_v\) has no degree below \(ij\), so \((A_+J_v)_{ij}=0\); injectivity follows directly.

Therefore the requested lower-adjoined target is established:
\[
J_v/A_+J_v\cong
\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^a}\mathbb Z\,[\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}]
\cong\mathbb Z^{\binom{a+b}{a}},
\]
and
\[
\operatorname{Hilb}_{J_v/A_+J_v}(z)
=z^{ij}\binom{a+b}{a}_z.
\]

## Gaps
No conclusion for the right-adjoined family is established here. The source remarks that a transposed argument could prove its minimality, but this is not an integral indecomposables proof.
